Name: Avatar Deathmatch
Overview: Avatar Deathmatch is a family-friendly multiplayer first-person shooter in which players, represented as their Xbox Avatars, battle each other in a colorful 3D environment. Although the weapons are based on real weapons such as handguns, uzis, and shotguns, they only shoot foam-esque projectiles which arc in the air, and players are 'knocked out' rather than killed. There is a god mode power-up that makes players invulnerable for a limited amount of time when collected. Each round lasts for 10 minutes and the player who has scored the most knockouts by the end of the round wins.
